_doc: The progressive-training config of 2026-11-25, read by envs/limits.py, envs/curriculum.py and envs/terrain.py. physics: the hard limits on a fighter's drives (train_box.py --gravity-scale/--torque-cap/--act-lag/--soft-limit); gravity is +- a share of g drawn per world (0 = Earth exactly, which is what the game runs), torque_cap is the share of each drive's force limit the motor may use, act_lag_hz is a first-order motor bandwidth (0 = the drive follows the target at once), soft_limit is the radians inside a joint's range where its stop starts to give and rom_w the charge per radian pressed into it. terrain: the floor classes of the terrain rung (a share of the episodes on each), each a slope range in degrees, a contact-friction factor and an uneven-ground bump rate (Hz) of bump_mps. nav: the navigation rung's pay per m/s of progress, its arrival bonus, and the range of obstacle counts parked across the path. curriculum: the rungs of balance -> walk -> sprint -> navigate, each with the env knobs it sets and the stats (value, [op, threshold]) that promote or demote a run; hold = updates in a row a condition must hold, ema = the smoothing of the stats (0 = none), min_iters = least iterations a rung is held before it may promote.
